summary: Fix the scp file name mismatch error by using SFTP via ssh_transfer_method smart or sftp (inventory var, env var or ansible.cfg), or if SCP is required pass -T through scp_extra_args; an 'invalid argument' for -T means your scp doesn't validate.
questions: How do I force Ansible to use sftp instead of scp?

answer_card.title: Use SFTP or scp -T to fix fetch errors
answer_card.answer_md:
Prefer SFTP:

```ini
[ssh_connection]
ssh_transfer_method = smart   # sftp, then scp, then dd
# or: sftp (fail if SFTP unavailable)
```

(or `ansible_ssh_transfer_method: smart` / `ANSIBLE_SSH_TRANSFER_METHOD=smart`).

If you must use SCP, add `-T`: `ansible_scp_extra_args=-T`, `ANSIBLE_SCP_EXTRA_ARGS=-T`, or `scp_extra_args = -T`. If `-T` gives *invalid argument*, your scp doesn't validate names and isn't affected.
